purpose: W2-F foundation: add source-backed, versioned seller netback and buyer landed-cost authority using exact Money/measures and accepted Commercial Rules, without mutating Settlement or creating live-money claims.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue the supplied PC-CROP post-registration specification with existing push/PR/merge authorization. Implementation remains blocked until this finite scope is independently accepted and promoted into immutable base-state authority.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: The existing calculator is explicitly not live-money authority. W2-F builds a new source-backed read/projection authority first instead of mutating Settlement semantics.
The first slice is an unmounted authority foundation so it can proceed in parallel; API exposure is a later consumer slice.
Accepted CommercialRuleSet/RulePack/Decision authority is reused read-only and must not be broadened by this slice.
Deal facts are later input consumers after W2-C; this foundation accepts explicit server-side source snapshots in isolated authority tests and does not mutate Deal.
Global CI remains an independent gate.
The generic migration checker discovers additive migrations dynamically and remains unchanged.

requiredInvariants: All monetary inputs and outputs use integer minor units / exact Money types; no Float, binary floating arithmetic or caller-formatted totals become authority.
All quantities use pinned measure/unit rules. Unit conversions and rounding policies are versioned and reproducible.
Seller netback and buyer landed cost are separate projections over one immutable commercial basis; neither projection mutates Deal, Settlement, ledger, payment or invoice state.
Every projection stores the exact source snapshot identifiers and versions for price/quantity, logistics cost, service cost, commercial rules, tax/fee assumptions and any other included component.
A projection with missing mandatory facts returns MISSING_FACTS/NOT_READY rather than inserting defaults that look authoritative.
Unversioned environment defaults, browser-supplied rates, legacy numeric shapes and hidden fallback fees are rejected from authoritative calculations.
CommercialRuleSet/RulePack/Decision are consumed read-only and pinned by identity/version/hash; later rule publication never rewrites a historical economics snapshot.
Every line item is explainable: code, payer perspective, amount, sourceRef, sourceVersion and inclusion rationale are persisted so the total can be recomputed.
Recalculation creates a new immutable projection version; accepted historical snapshots are never overwritten.
Current tenant/organization scope is required for write and read authority. Cross-tenant and same-tenant outsider access is denied under FORCE RLS.
Mutation, audit and outbox evidence commit atomically with payload-bound idempotency and optimistic versioning; missing evidence rolls back the projection receipt.

Registration, Role Eligibility, Auction/Inventory, Deal allocation, Progressive Trust, Two-Sided Market, Settlement, Federal Accounting lock #4321, packages/lockfiles and production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Domain tests prove exact arithmetic, unit conversions, rounding, missing-facts behavior and seller/buyer perspective separation over large values beyond JavaScript safe integer boundaries.
Restricted PostgreSQL tests prove immutable versioned snapshots, exact replay, changed-payload conflict, CAS/stale rejection, tenant isolation and outsider denial.
Changing a Commercial Rule version creates a new projection while preserving the prior snapshot and its exact total.
Missing logistics/service/tax facts are explicit gaps and never silently replaced by zero or environment defaults unless the pinned rule explicitly defines zero.
Line-item sum equals authoritative total exactly in minor units; source refs/versions are complete for every included component.
Audit/outbox failure rolls back projection/version/receipt atomically.
No Settlement/ledger/payment mutation occurs in W2-F foundation and no UI/API claims live payable/receivable money from these projections.
Forward migrations, zero public-schema drift, backup/restore, cryptographic freshness and exact-head CI/review pass while global independent gates remain unchanged.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Mounted buyer/seller economics APIs and role UX remain later consumer work.
Authoritative Deal/Offer/Logistics/Service/Tax input wiring remains after their respective source authorities are accepted.
Commercial projections do not become financial obligations; SettlementPlan and obligation ledger remain separate W3/W6 work.
Verified REG.RU runtime and real-user price decision acceptance remain required before terminal NETBACK/LANDED_COST credit.
